question: What claim about the authority of the yoginī named Icchā is made by stating that she was named by the siddhas up to Māyā by supreme will?
premises: She was named by the siddhas.
This naming extends up to Māyā and occurs by supreme will.
inference: The yoginī Icchā was named by the siddhas up to the limit of Māyā by supreme will.
uncertainties: The significance of 'up to Māyā' is not specified here.
plain_english: The yoginī named Icchā was named by the siddhas up to Māyā by supreme will.
